title: Crafting recipe file (data/crafting/<id>.json, one recipe per file)
description: Something made at the workbench or smelted in the furnace at the hero's home (GDD §14, TECH_DESIGN §28): where it is made, what it needs, what it makes, and when the hero knows it. Every item id must be in data/items. The workbench lists every recipe of its own that the hero knows, in 'order'; the furnace offers its own. Adding one needs no code. (Cooking has its own folder and schema: data/recipes, recipe.schema.json.)

name.description: What the list calls it. Left out, it is the name of the item it makes. A recipe that makes a furnishing needs one.

station.description: Where it is made. A 'furnace' recipe is smelted overnight, several to a load (data/rules/crafting.json: furnace_most), and must make an item.

tab.description: The tab of the workbench's list it is on (the Homestead, TECH_DESIGN §30): 'make', what is made for use, 'place', what is made to be set down on the hero's land (it makes a placeable), or 'build' (phase 3): a building's plan, which makes its kit, or its upgrade. A plan names its coins as a need (the item 'coin'); refused, it says what he is short of by name. Only a workbench recipe may name one.

order.description: Its place on its station's list (its tab's, at the workbench), lowest first; recipes that share a number are listed by id.

needs.description: What is used up, each with how many. A tool made from another names the old tool here.

makes.description: An item for the pack (which may be a placeable, or a building's kit), a furnishing of the hero's home or of a building's room, or (the 'build' tab) a building's upgrade: one of the three.

furnishing.description: One of the furnishings in data/rules/crafting.json: the home's 'furnishings', or with 'room' one of that room's ('rooms'). It is made once, and stands in its own place in that room (a Furnishing node in its scene): its flag is 'home/<furnishing>', or '<room>/<furnishing>'.

room.description: The room the furnishing stands in: 'home' (the farmhouse), or a building's room named in data/rules/crafting.json 'rooms' (the shed).

upgrade.description: A building (data/buildings) with a 'big' form: bought for one that stands, it is finished the next morning, in the same place and of the same size. One upgrade a building.

unlock.description: When the hero knows the recipe. Left out, from the start. One of the three: an item 'found' (ever held, even if he has none now), a 'skill' at a 'level', or a building 'built' (one that stands on his land today; a site doesn't count).

level.description: Every skill begins at level 1, so 2 is the first that waits on anything.
